longDescription: Creates a self-contained, beginner-friendly HTML explainer with large visuals, plain language, progressive steps, and faithful visual-reference matching.
starterPrompts: Explain how DNS works with a visual ELI5 page.
Turn this idea into a picture-first explainer.
Match this visual reference as an ELI5 HTML page.
availability: All countries and regions available in the OpenAI submission portal
releaseNotes: Initial public-directory submission of ELI5 for Codex. The skills-only plugin creates self-contained, picture-first HTML explainers, includes a dependency-free validator, supports visual-reference matching, and requires no account, MCP server, or reviewer credentials. Version 0.2.3 adds directory-limit metadata and public support, privacy, and terms links.
